typing_correction.unnecessary_demand: A copying map U_Ev->U_Ev tensor M_5 is not required if the complete Evans Rosenbrock state itself has linear bulk, endpoint-trace, and tail observers.
typing_correction.correct_target: the represented five-cell response carrier bulk_Phi direct-sum endpoint_plane direct-sum tail_plane
typing_correction.correct_map_kind: one linear observer/natural transformation, not a diagonal or coaugmentation

candidate_components.bulk: B_bulk(f_-,f_+,c)=c bulk_Phi, induced by the source incidence c maps to c(Phi_-,Phi_+)
candidate_components.endpoint: B_end=H_partial tau_boundary(f_-,f_+), the complete wall/jump trace; its normalized coefficient images are w_theta and j_theta
candidate_components.tail: B_tail=(K(f_-,f_+),V(f_-,f_+)), retaining the two oriented history/tail coordinates rather than scalar-compressing them

linearity_and_Xi.linearity: source incidence, endpoint trace, Hadamard wall/jump conversion, and tail observers are each linear
linearity_and_Xi.Evans_identity: on the stable section i(z)=(u_-(z),u_+(z),1), C i(z)=tau(z)
linearity_and_Xi.multiplicity: z derivatives of i(z) are carried linearly, so no tau^2 or absolute-square multiplicity distortion is introduced

available_naturality.endpoint: moving-seam transport plus complete endpoint pushforward is an exact metric natural transformation and is Fourier-saturated
available_naturality.coefficient_C4: Phi is fixed, one swaps with delta_0, and (K,V) quarter-turn as K->V->-K
available_naturality.still_to_identify: the analytic tail observers of the two stable histories with the fixture's K,V coefficient cells on one common closed domain

joint_chain_gate.required_square: B_Ev R_Xi(z) equals the five-cell pair/bordered differential applied to B_Ev(f_-,f_+,c), with seam mismatch retained as the transverse output
joint_chain_gate.why_nontrivial: the component maps exist at different construction stages and domains; their direct sum is not a chain map until source normalization, wall graph closure, and tail orientation agree
joint_chain_gate.positive_followup: only after this square may the faithful joint Green graph and Clifford positive crossing be applied to the Xi kernel state

conclusion: The independent Evans carrier already contains the data that the five cells observe: constant forcing amplitude, two endpoint traces, and two oriented history coordinates. Therefore the bridge should be assembled as a linear observer of the Rosenbrock state, avoiding any forbidden copying. The open theorem is the common-domain chain/naturality square, especially identification of the analytic tail pair with K,V and retention of the seam mismatch as a transverse output.
